title: Jake Barber at sites where ET craft were targeted and downed
summary: Steven Greer tells of Jake Barber at sites where ET craft were targeted and downed, about unspecified at Sites around the world (map in briefing document), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Sites around the world (map in briefing document)

tellings.quote: So, he's been a site where we've targeted these ET craft and down them.

plain: Steven Greer, a longtime campaigner for UFO disclosure, says that Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot, has been at sites where, in Greer's words, "we" targeted extraterrestrial craft and brought them down. Greer points to a map of such sites around the world in a briefing document he has put together. If true, it would mean humans have been deliberately shooting down craft from elsewhere.
